doc.title: Architecture - Validation Layers
doc.snippet: Layer 3 Order Lifecycle: order creation, execution, fills, state transitions. Events: order_created, order_submitted, order_filled, order_cancelled.

doc.title: PRD - Order Lifecycle Validation
doc.snippet: System can compare order lifecycle logs to validate order creation timing. System can compare order execution correctness. System can compare order state transitions.

doc.title: PRD - Order Execution Fidelity
doc.snippet: Market orders: Immediate fill at current price. Limit orders: Fill when price crosses limit. Order lifecycle: Created->Submitted->Filled/Cancelled.
